descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S14 「AI Check：很难认的名字被标出来，而不是被猜（5 医院 + 5 养老院）」 AI Check: a hard-to-read name is flagged, not guessed (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 AI Check: on a list with one hard-to-read name, the app flags that name as unclear and does not guess a plausible-looking one. …（UAT TC-02 AI Check；TFA-92580 AC 6；UAT 3.2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 6；TFA-92580 How it works 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92580 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Ten photos, each with 4 legible rows and 1 name a person cannot read. Each truth JSON records, per photo, the hidden name and the fragment a person can still see

When Each photo is read by scanCensusSheet in its mode and then by the client's own clean-up (cleanScannedName + isLikelyPatientRow for Hospital, extractedResidents for Nursing Home)

Then The unreadable row is still there, marked unclear, with no plausible name in its place. The 4 legible rows are read correctly

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per photo, on the row at room 605 / unit Birch 15 after the client clean-up. Pass: its name matches /\?|\[unclear\]|\bunclear\b|\billegible\b|unreadable/i, or the row carries unclear: true and S28 shows the scan sheet displays that flag (a field the client does not show is 'flag not shown', Fail). Fail (silent drop): the row is missing; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
